app.name: Miu Music
language.label: Language
folders.title: Watched folders
folders.encodingTitle: Tag encoding (for old files with garbled titles)
device.title: Device
device.plugIn: Plug in your iPhone with a USB cable
device.trust: Unlock your iPhone and tap Trust
prereq.title: Apple drivers needed
prereq.body: Miu Music talks to your iPhone through Apple’s drivers. Install the free Apple Devices app (or iTunes) from the Microsoft Store, then restart Miu Music.
empty.title: Add your music
empty.body: Choose one or more folders to watch, or drop them here. Miu keeps up with new and removed songs.
search.label: Search
filters.label: Filter by rating
disliked.banner: Disliked songs never sync to your iPhone. Delete moves them to the Recycle Bin and out of Miu Music. Tap the thumbs-down again to keep a song.
duplicates.note: Songs with the same audio, whatever their names or tags. Copies sit next to each other; hover a song to see where its file is.
columns.title: Title
index.label: Jump to letter
delete.message: {names} will be moved to the Recycle Bin and removed from Miu Music. You can restore files from the Recycle Bin.
delete.moved.one: Moved {n} song to the Recycle Bin.
delete.moved.other: Moved {n} songs to the Recycle Bin.
mini.hint: Double-click a song in Miu Music
mini.pinOff: Keep on top of other windows
mini.vizStyle: Click to change the visualizer style
eq.title: Equalizer
eq.clip: May distort: lower the preamp by {db} dB
output.title: Output
output.exclusiveNote: Miu takes the device for itself: other apps are silent while it plays, and the Windows volume no longer applies — set the level with Miu's volume or on your amplifier.
output.fallback: Exclusive mode was refused (another app holds the device, or it takes no matching format), so Miu is playing in shared mode.
editor.title: Title
editor.patternMissed.one: {n} file name did not match the pattern.
editor.patternMissed.other: {n} file names did not match the pattern.
sync.noSpace: Not enough space on the iPhone: needs {need}, {available} available.
settings.title: Settings
settings.miniOnMinimize: Open the mini player when the window is minimised
settings.miniOnTop: Keep the mini player above other windows
conv.alac24_48: 24-bit / 48 kHz — the best the iPhone plays
settings.conversionNote: Only the copies on the iPhone are converted. Your files and playback on this PC stay as they are.
error.drivers-missing.title: Apple drivers needed
error.drivers-missing.body: Miu Music talks to your iPhone through Apple’s drivers. Install the free Apple Devices app from the Microsoft Store, then restart Miu Music.
error.device-untrusted.title: Trust this computer
error.device-untrusted.body: Unlock your iPhone and tap Trust when it asks about this computer. Then try again.
error.device-locked.title: iPhone is locked
error.device-locked.body: Unlock your iPhone with its passcode and keep it unlocked while Miu reads it.
error.device-disconnected.title: iPhone disconnected
error.device-disconnected.body: The cable came loose or the iPhone restarted. Plug it in again; nothing on it was changed.
error.device-busy.title: iPhone is busy
error.device-busy.body: Another program (iTunes, Apple Devices or 3uTools) is using the iPhone. Close it, then try again.
error.no-space.title: Not enough space on the iPhone
error.no-space.body: This sync needs {need} but only {available} is free. Unlike some songs or choose smaller iPhone copies in Settings.
error.folder-missing.title: Folder not found
error.folder-missing.body: {path} is not there any more. If it is on a drive that is unplugged, plug it in; otherwise stop watching it.
error.sync-unavailable.title: Sync is not ready yet
error.sync-unavailable.body: Sending songs into the Music app needs an Apple authorisation step that Miu cannot do yet. Your library and ratings are kept for when it can.
error.output-busy.title: Sound device is busy
error.output-busy.body: Another app holds the sound device in exclusive mode. Close it or choose another output.
error.unknown.title: Something went wrong
error.unknown.body: Miu ran into a problem it does not know how to explain. The details below help when reporting it.
wizard.title: Welcome to Miu Music
wizard.driversBody: Free from the Microsoft Store (the Apple Devices app).
wizard.phoneBody: Use a USB cable. You can also skip this and just play music.
wizard.foldersBody: Miu watches them and keeps up with new songs.
settings.diagnostics: Logs and device facts for a bug report. No music, databases or account details are included.
sync.title: Your iPhone
podcast.empty: No podcasts yet. Paste a feed address above to subscribe.
podcast.topUs: Top podcasts in the United States
album.alwaysSyncHint: Like every song here, and new ones later, so they sync to the iPhone
sync.stage.backup: Backing up the iPhone’s music database…
sync.stage.copyOff.one: Keeping a copy of {n} song that is only on the iPhone…
sync.stage.copyOff.other: Keeping a copy of {n} songs that are only on the iPhone…
sync.stage.check: Checking what iTunes sees on the iPhone…
sync.stage.waiting: Waiting for the iPhone to show the changes…
sync.stage.verify: Checking the iPhone after the sync…
sync.adopted.one: {n} liked song was already on the iPhone.
sync.adopted.other: {n} liked songs were already on the iPhone.
sync.failedSongs.other: {n} songs could not go, for example: {reason}
sync.lost: The sync removed “{title}” without being asked. A copy is in Miu’s backups folder.
sync.unconfirmed: The iPhone has not shown every change yet.
sync.goneFromPhone.one: {n} song deleted on the iPhone was sent again.
sync.goneFromPhone.other: {n} songs deleted on the iPhone were sent again.
sync.manualHint: iTunes refused every song. Turn on “Manually manage music and videos” for this iPhone in iTunes, then sync again.
sync.guide1: Open iTunes and click the iPhone button near the top left.
sync.guide2: In Summary, under Options, tick “Manually manage music and videos”, then click Apply.
sync.guide3: Keep iTunes open while Miu syncs. Songs already on the iPhone stay.
settings.coversNote: Look up covers online for albums that have none (iTunes and MusicBrainz, free). Your music files are not changed.
settings.coversStarted.one: Looking up {n} album. Covers appear as they are found.
settings.coversStarted.other: Looking up {n} albums. Covers appear as they are found.
settings.coversNone: Every album has a cover, or was looked up recently.
book.empty: No audiobooks yet. Find free ones on LibriVox.
book.search: Search LibriVox by title or author
book.about: Free public-domain audiobooks from LibriVox, read by volunteers.
book.noneIn: No books in {language} here. LibriVox has few or no recordings in some languages yet.
player.title: Music players
player.suggested: This drive has a Music folder. Sync to use it as a music player.
player.add: Use a drive as a player…
player.addHint: Pick the folder on a USB drive or memory card that your player reads music from
player.gone.one: {n} song deleted on the player was copied again.
player.gone.other: {n} songs deleted on the player were copied again.
player.leftAlone.one: {n} file changed on the player was left there.
player.leftAlone.other: {n} files changed on the player were left there.
player.noSpace: Not enough space on the player: needs {need}, {available} available.
player.mtpHint: Keep the phone unlocked and set to File transfer while it syncs.
